name: BILL
description: BILL is a financial operations platform for small and midsize businesses and accounting firms, combining a free corporate card and spend-control product (BILL Spend & Expense) with paid, subscription-based accounts payable and receivable automation (BILL AP & AR).
best_for: Small and midsize businesses and accounting firms wanting a free corporate card and budgeting product alongside optional, per-user accounts payable and receivable automation.
pros: BILL Spend & Expense (cards and budgets) has no per-user or subscription software fees
Deep two-way accounting sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and Microsoft Dynamics
Corporate card credit lines from $1,000 up to $5M for qualifying businesses
cons: AP & AR automation is a separate, per-user subscription starting at $49/user/month on top of the free card product
Enterprise-tier AP & AR pricing and its ERP-grade integrations require contacting sales
Advertised Divvy Card credit lines are not guaranteed and depend on application approval
features: BILL Spend & Expense: free corporate cards (the BILL Divvy Card) with custom budgets, card limits, and automated approval workflows
Accounts payable automation: bill capture, approval workflows, and vendor payments via ACH, check, or card
Accounts receivable automation: invoice creation, delivery, and payment collection
Receipt capture by photo or text with AI-assisted invoice field coding
Procurement (Corporate plan and above): purchase requests, purchase orders, tolerance rules, and 2-way matching
Two-way sync with QuickBooks Online/Pro/Premier/Enterprise, Xero, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, and Acumatica
Multi-entity accounting, single sign-on, and API access on the Enterprise plan

pricing.starting_price: $0/user/month (BILL Spend & Expense); AP & AR automation from $49/user/month

tiers.name: Spend & Expense
tiers.notes: Free corporate card and budgeting product (formerly Divvy) with no per-user or subscription software fees; monetized through card interchange and payment transaction fees. Includes unlimited free virtual cards and credit lines from $1,000-$5M for approved applicants (not guaranteed).

tiers.name: AP & AR Essentials
tiers.notes: Bill entry, approval workflows, ACH/virtual/credit card vendor payments, W-9 collection, AI invoice coding, and 6 standard user roles.

tiers.name: AP & AR Team
tiers.notes: Adds automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Online/Pro/Premier and Xero, plus custom user roles.

tiers.name: AP & AR Corporate
tiers.notes: Most popular self-serve tier. Adds procurement (purchase requests/orders, tolerance rules, 2-way matching) and custom approval policies.

tiers.name: AP & AR Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing via sales. Adds sync with QuickBooks Enterprise, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and Microsoft Dynamics, plus SSO, dual control, multi-entity accounting, API access, and priority support.

alternatives.name: Tipalti
alternatives.description: A finance automation platform for accounts payable and global mass payments, built for high-volume international payouts.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-market and enterprise finance teams paying suppliers or partners across many countries and currencies.
strengths: Self-service payee portal with tax form collection
AI agents for invoice capture and PO matching

alternatives.name: Ramp
alternatives.description: A spend management platform combining a fee-free corporate card with AI-driven expense, AP, and procurement automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a free corporate card paired with automated expense and accounts-payable workflows.
strengths: Free plan with no annual fees or interest charges on the card
Zero processing fees on domestic ACH, check, and card AP payments
Native bidirectional sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct

alternatives.name: Expensify
alternatives.description: An expense management platform with receipt scanning, a commercial card, and in-app travel booking.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting simple receipt-driven expense reports, with discounted pricing when paired with the Expensify Card.
strengths: Up to 50% subscription discount for Expensify Card usage
